recap: Collin Sexton led the Cavaliers with 27 points (9-16 FG, 3-4 3PT), 2 rebounds and 5 assists.
Terry Rozier led the Hornets with 42 points (15-23 FG, 10-16 3PT), 3 rebounds and 2 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 60.9 to 58.9.
Biggest swing: Miles Bridges misses 18-foot two point fade away jump shot (Q2 8:54), +9 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Nance, Sexton, Garland, Okoro, McGee, +9 in 4:40.
Bench points: CLE 34, CHA 24. Points in the paint: 62–56. Second-chance points: 8–8.
